checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add decibel-based WAV gain

impact_assessment.why: Needs a simple level trim in dB without re-rendering from the score; normalization only targets peak or RMS.
impact_assessment.benefits: gain applies an exact linear factor from dB to a Coda WAV, with 0 dB byte-identical and clamping handled deterministically.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: 0 dB must be an identity, -6 dB must halve amplitude within quantization, invalid WAVs must fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a pure gain module with exact byte tests, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 246 tests green; 0 dB identity and -6.0206 dB halving pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-gain' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add DC-offset removal for WAVs

impact_assessment.why: Recorded or synthesized audio can carry a constant offset that wastes headroom; no Coda tool removes it.
impact_assessment.benefits: dc measures the per-channel mean and subtracts it deterministically, with zero-mean input left byte-identical.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the mean must be computed over all frames, zero-mean input must be an identity within quantization, and invalid WAVs must fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a pure DC module with exact byte tests using a known offset signal, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 250 tests green; DC removal identity and known-offset byte tests pass
Task 'coda-dc' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add leading/trailing silence padding

impact_assessment.why: Assembling sections often needs exact silence gaps, which currently requires external tools or hand-built WAVs.
impact_assessment.benefits: pad prepends and appends exact durations of silence while preserving all audio bytes and the sample rate.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: frame counts must round correctly, existing audio must shift unchanged, invalid WAVs must fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a pure pad module with exact header and byte-shift tests, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

Task 'coda-pad' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add explicit fade durations for WAV files

impact_assessment.why: Named presets cover common cases, but exact fade lengths are needed to fit a specific transition.
impact_assessment.benefits: fade-to applies --fade-in/--fade-out seconds to any Coda WAV using the shared fade engine, with zero durations as an identity.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: durations must be non-negative, zero/zero must be byte-identical, and invalid WAVs must fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for exact edge attenuation, a CLI command reusing the shared fade function, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 256 tests green; exact fade durations, head attenuation and zero identity pinned
Task 'coda-fade-seconds' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add interval-based harmonization

impact_assessment.why: Scores can be transposed and varied but cannot spawn harmony voices from an existing melody.
impact_assessment.benefits: harmonize adds notes at chosen semitone intervals with reduced velocity, producing editable canonical source.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: original notes must be unchanged, added pitches must stay in valid MIDI range, and invalid intervals must fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for pitches, velocity scaling and round-trip, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add chord-to-arpeggio transformation

impact_assessment.why: Chords are easy to write as simultaneous notes but there is no way to roll them into a sequence.
impact_assessment.benefits: arpeggiate spreads each simultaneity across a grid with unchanged notes and deterministic ordering.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: note count and fields must be preserved, ordering must be stable, and invalid grids must fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for grid spacing, preservation and round-trip, a CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.
